page.title: Activities and currencies
page.subtitle: The activity sets how branches and products behave, and the base currency is the unit for every report
page.sector_hint: The sector sets which screens you and your employees see. It has no effect until you choose a primary activity.
page.currency_rate: Exchange rate against the base currency
page.rates_hint: One rate is kept per day: recording the same date again updates the rate instead of adding a new line. A posted document keeps the rate it was posted with and is never repriced.
page.delete_activity_body: "{{name}}" will be deleted. It cannot be deleted while linked to branches or products.
page.delete_currency_body: "{{code}}" will be deleted. It cannot be deleted while used in any document.

primary_activity.err_preview: Could not work out the effect of the change
primary_activity.err_apply: Could not change the primary activity
primary_activity.data_note_strong: the data stays as it is
primary_activity.data_note_after: . Not a single row is deleted, and you can undo at any time.

cash_drawers.title: Cash drawers
cash_drawers.intro: Each drawer gets its own account in the chart of accounts when it is created, so each drawer's shortage is known separately. Earlier shifts are assigned to their branch's “default drawer”.
cash_drawers.band_low: ⚠ {{remaining}} of {{capacity}} slots left in the {{band}} code range, and deleting a drawer does not free its code. Contact us before it runs out.
cash_drawers.band_full: ⛔ The {{band}} code range is full: no new drawer can be created until the range is extended. Contact us.

integrations.title: Integrations
integrations.subtitle: Payment gateways, buy now pay later and stores. Keys are stored encrypted and shown masked
integrations.empty: No connections yet. When your real provider's keys are available, connect them here with no extra development
integrations.delete_body: Delete the "{{kind}}" connection? Operations through this provider stop immediately.

api_keys.title: System API keys
api_keys.subtitle: Given to an external system that connects to your data, with only the permissions of the template you choose. The key is shown once when created, so copy it before closing the message.
api_keys.copy_now: Copy the key now. It will not be shown again
api_keys.name_placeholder: Key name, e.g. Our online store

support.title: Technical support and access to your data
support.subtitle: Support never enters your data without your approval, for a time you set, read only, and everything it does is logged here
support.empty: No pending support requests and no open windows
support.log_empty: Support has never entered your data
